CN.title: DeepLink获SAIL奖，发布生态合作伙伴计划 | WAIC 2024
CN.introduction: 7月4日，2024世界人工智能大会暨人工智能全球治理高级别会议（WAIC 2024）在上海开幕。当天，WAIC卓越人工智能引领奖（Super AI Leader，简称SAIL奖）揭晓。上海人工智能实验室（上海AI实验室）浦源·DeepLink人工智能开放计算体系从200余个候选项目中脱颖而出，荣获本年度SAIL – 超越奖（Superior）。

content.content: 7月4日，2024世界人工智能大会暨人工智能全球治理高级别会议（WAIC 2024）在上海开幕。当天，WAIC卓越人工智能引领奖（Super AI Leader，简称SAIL奖）揭晓。上海人工智能实验室（上海AI实验室）浦源·DeepLink人工智能开放计算体系从200余个候选项目中脱颖而出，荣获本年度SAIL – 超越奖（Superior）。
news-0715-content.PNG
上海AI实验室领军科学家林达华教授（左一）代表实验室领奖
作为WAIC最高奖项，SAIL奖于2018年设立，每年从全球范围评选，用于表彰引领技术创新变革、创造未来美好生活的全球人工智能创新项目。SAIL奖分设代表（Superior）、赋能（Applicative）、创新（Innovative）、引领（Leading）的五个子奖项，获奖项目均在人工智能领域获高度认可和美誉。
news-0715.JPEG
适配、评测、标准并举，支撑产业落地
浦源·DeepLink 人工智能开放计算体系（以下简称“DeepLink”）旨在搭建对硬件芯片与深度学习软件框架进行适配的桥梁，共建开放的软硬件适配生态，为各类主流智算芯片提供统一、便捷的编程接口，实现人工智能训练框架与底层硬件架构间的解耦。
基于DeepLink，开发者通过一次编程，即可自由在各类硬件和算法生态中切换，大幅缩短适配时间，整体降低算力使用门槛。
目前，DeepLink已与10余家硬件企业展开合作。在多个计算平台实现了多个模型的训练和推理适配。
DeepLink面向全行业积极主导芯片评测工作，完善大模型时代下的AI算力评估方法和基准，为芯片企业产品迭代、智算中心选型提供指导。截至目前，DeepLink已开展7次芯片评测工作，产出约70份评测报告供厂商迭代自身产品，具备千卡体量的测试方案，并推动了多个国家、地方标准的制定。
开放共建，汇聚生态合作伙伴
在7月4日举办的WAIC 2024科学前沿主论坛上，浦源·DeepLink生态合作伙伴计划正式发布，首批汇聚20余家机构加入。此计划旨在搭建中立、高效的桥梁，为算力提供方、使用方，以及智算中心建设方等伙伴提供交流及需求对接的平台，助力提升国产算力的易用性。
在生态计划体系中，算力提供方和应用机构将以会议交流、适配认证、芯片评测等形式为路径深度交融，加快研发成果的落地推广，共同推进生态建设，打造软硬件适配落地示范标杆。
同时，该计划将从AI硬件评测、与软件适配性、标准三个方面着手，以公平中立的视角联合各方制定评级认证标准。合作伙伴将根据评级，获得联合研发、联合授权、资源共享、培训赋能等权益。

CN.title: OpenTenNet框架：软硬件协同，突破量子计算能效壁垒
CN.introduction: 近期，上海人工智能实验室（上海AI实验室）联合中国科学技术大学、中国科学院等共同发布量子模拟并行框架OpenTenNet，以软硬件协同突破“量子霸权”能效壁垒，为人工智能算力基础提供新的算法支撑。

content.content: 近期，上海人工智能实验室（上海AI实验室）联合中国科学技术大学、中国科学院等共同发布量子模拟并行框架OpenTenNet，以软硬件协同突破“量子霸权”能效壁垒，为人工智能算力基础提供新的算法支撑。
融合OpenTenNet及新兴算力集群系统优化，研究团队联合沐曦，首次在新兴算力硬件上构建了量子计算模拟器，实现扩展性、计算效率、绿色能耗等方面的性能提升，在传统硬件模式下，进一步降低了“量子计算”的应用门槛。
相关成果论文已发表于2024全球超级计算大会（SC24），未来，实验室将持续依托原创算法与新兴算力，加速构建AI软硬件适配桥梁，与各方携手，推进AI算法与算力应用创新。
论文链接：https://ieeexplore.ieee.org/abstract/document/10793197
开源链接：https://github.com/DeepLink-org/OpenTenNet
“量子”与“经典”竞争，催生创新动力

量子计算是基于量子力学原理发展形成的信息处理的概念和技术体系，被认为有机会实现指数级别的计算效率加速，同时因其不受经典计算机晶体管极限的限制，受到研究界广泛关注。由于复杂且高度纠缠的量子系统难以使用经典计算机高效模拟，物理学家费曼进而提出利用可控的量子计算机研究量子系统，并实现量子计算的高效应用。此前，量子芯片Sycamore曾于特定任务上超越了经典计算机的能力，宣告“量子霸权”实现。随着量子计算在NISQ（含噪声中等规模量子）不断展现出来的潜力，各类经典计算机上的量子电路模拟器应运而生，以传统硬件弥合“量子霸权”成为研究界的关注重点。但与此同时，经典计算机模拟量子电路存在以下挑战：
1. 组成量子系统的量子比特数量多（对应空间复杂度）；
2. 量子系统的纵向深（对应时间复杂度）；
3. 量子电路规模的扩大，所需的信息量呈指数级增长。
OpenTenNet框架高效实现量子模拟器
此前业界利用超算集群，取得了一定的量子模拟研究进展，但超大规模张量网络缩并产生的通信开销和能耗负担，依然是经典计算冲击“量子霸权”的阻碍。
针对量子模拟中的大规模张量网络缩并，上海AI实验室联合团队结合中科大最新提出的量子模拟算法推出OpenTenNet框架，解决内存受限条件下的计算效率和开销问题。利用三级并行架构、定制化低精度通信、重计算等技术，缓解节点间的通信瓶颈，首次在新型算力硬件上构建出高性能低功耗量子线路模拟器。
通过OpenTenNet算法，研究团队将量子模拟任务转化为大规模张量网络的缩并问题，在内存受限的条件下使用“模拟退火”搜索出一条计算复杂度近似最优的缩并路径，并使用后选择处理算法以提高交叉熵基准测试XEB值，相同XEB值下计算量更低。
对标量子芯片Sycamore实现“量子霸权”的任务，联合团队在不同张量网络规模下进行了多组对照实验。结合算法和系统级优化，基于OpenTenNet的量子模拟器在可扩展性、速度、功耗等方面实现了性能提升。如下图所示，随着GPU数量的增加，总任务所需的时间呈线性下降，能耗同时保持在稳定水平，表现出良好的并行性和高度可扩展性。
news-250124-1.png
OpenTenNet扩展性分析
软硬件协同，突破“量子霸权”
基于OpenTenNet算法，研究团队联合沐曦，在MX C500芯片上对量子模型进行一系列适配与优化：根据访存特征优化的高维Tensor操作算子，充分利用GPU Matrix Core实现的高性能GEMM计算数学库，高带宽低延时的通讯库实现卡间数据传输。
测试结果如下图，其中矩形代表量子芯片Sycamore，三角形代表已有的经典模拟算法，圆形代表上海AI实验室联合团队构建的量子模拟计算器。以Sycamore产生三百万个不相关的采样实验作为对照，可见最新的量子模拟计算方法对比Sycamore已取得能耗及效率优势（粉红色区域）。经典算力凭借软硬件协同，已成功超越Sycamore“量子霸权”。
news-250124-2.png
上海AI实验室持续布局新一代AI训练与计算系统构建，打造具有广泛包容性的AI计算与编译体系，创新训练系统编程范式，探索模型训练的能效极限，应对通用智能与超大规模科学计算融合的需求。由实验室构建的DeepLink人工智能开放计算体系，搭建算力硬件与深度学习软件框架适配的桥梁，从软、硬件两方面共同助力人工智能技术突破。

CN.title: DeepLink桥接新兴算力，书生覆盖全能生成
CN.introduction: 11月26日，第三届算力网络与数字经济论坛暨2024年“算力浦江”总结大会在上海举行。会上，上海人工智能实验室（上海AI实验室）发布了开放计算及通专融合大模型的最新成果：首次在大模型训练中实现了全面由国产新兴算力异构互联技术支撑，完整训练出全能多模态生成大模型——书生·若明（InternLumina）。

content.content: 11月26日，第三届算力网络与数字经济论坛暨2024年“算力浦江”总结大会在上海举行。会上，上海人工智能实验室（上海AI实验室）发布了开放计算及通专融合大模型的最新成果：首次在大模型训练中实现了全面由国产新兴算力异构互联技术支撑，完整训练出全能多模态生成大模型——书生·若明（InternLumina）。
发挥原创算法及AI软硬件深度互联技术优势，上海AI实验室联合无问芯穹、天数智芯、沐曦科技及算丰信息等新兴算力提供方开展跨域异构互联技术探索，实现了异构混训技术新突破：实验结果表明，书生·若明在新兴算力组成的异构集群中混训效率达97.5%，计算效率较未优化前提升1.6倍。
书生·若明的能力范围涵盖覆盖多轮对话、视觉理解、可控生成、多轮编辑等多模态生成任务，可精准应对实际应用场景中的复杂挑战。在生成技术领域，上海AI实验室研究团队通过打造协同发展的算法框架，在兼具通用生成能力和专业泛化能力的“通专融合”技术路径上更进一步。
会上还发布了由上海市通信管理局的指导，实验室联合中国电信等机构主导制定的《智算中心能力验收规范》团体标准。以DeepLink人工智能开放计算体系为载体，上海AI实验室将持续推动人工智能软硬件深度耦合，与行业伙伴共同推动新兴算力高效应用与AI基础设施建设。

《智算中心能力验收规范》团体标准：
全能生成：精准应对复杂挑战
书生·若明能力范围涵盖多轮对话、视觉理解、可控生成、多轮编辑等多项任务。以多语种多粒度图像理解器、扩散图像生成模型、扩散视频生成模型、多任务全能生成模型为基座，构筑起“全能”多模态生成模型。
new1126_4.PNG
多项基座模型，构筑“全能生成”
图像理解器支持中英双语，支持高分辨率及任意分辨率的内容标注，用户可灵活定义从简单标签到长文本描述的多粒度内容理解方式，为其它任务构建坚实的基础；
图像生成模型针对中文社区AI创作的痛点，用户可通过中英双语生成多文化、多领域、多风格的高质量图像；
扩散视频生成模型可支持任意时长、任意分辨率、多种风格的视频生成；
全能生成模型全面涵盖多轮对话、视觉理解、可控生成、多轮编辑等多种任务，为多领域的智能生成提供强大的技术支撑。
为实现多模态、多任务、全能生成的研究目标，上海AI实验室研究团队引入指令交互式“理解-联想”机制及强化理解方法，使生成过程有序可控，生成效果“更靠谱”。基于指令交互式“理解-联想”机制，可为用户提供细粒度可控的创作手段，生成包括中国传统文化特征在内的多样化对话、图片、视频，从而赋能海报、动漫等设计创作，服务现实生活中的不同应用需求
遵循“强化理解”理念，研究团队为书生·若明定制开发了多语种多粒度超清分辨率图像理解器，打造输入内容的高效解析和生成语义基础。打标器适用于中英文双语，支持任意分辨率的内容标注，适应多样化场景理解，用户可灵活定义从单次标签到长文本描述的内容理解方式，解构复杂数据，确保了生成内容的精准度和丰富度，有效降低了生成模型中的“幻觉”现象，实现了“理解-生成”的协同演进。
异构混训：验证新兴算力跨域协同潜能
书生·若明作为首个基于新兴算力的异构混训多模态大模型，进一步突破了跨域异构互联技术的性能边界。
在计算资源有限的前提下，通过跨域异构互联，可实现不同算力性能的芯片自由组合，而无需依赖单一高算力芯片“抱团”；同时，不同算力集群可通过组合实现规模增效。通过异构互联，还可以降低不同算力厂商的硬件壁垒，促进生态繁荣。
然而，长期以来，由于硬件厂商之间的闭源性，芯片运行驱动、计算软件和上层框架不兼容，不同硬件间通信效率低下等问题，导致算力应用方难以同时调用两种以上的芯片进行计算，严重限制了算力使用效率。
以DeepLink人工智能开放计算体系为载体，上海AI实验室联合无问芯穹、天数智芯、沐曦科技及算丰信息等新兴算力供应方，首次成功实现了全面由新兴算力支撑的大模型混训。实验结果验证，在全新技术方案下，书生·若明在新兴算力组成的异构集群中，混训效率达97.5%，计算效率较未优化前提升1.6倍。
在异构芯片基础上，Deeplink团队基于现有通信协议构建适配层，协调不同硬件厂商以RDMA（Remote Direct Memory Access，远程直接内存访问）或CPU中转的方式达成异构芯片之间的互联通信，突破了异构芯片的闭源不兼容问题。
针对并行策略，Deeplink则使用自研InternEvo分布式并行框架，以更细粒度的拆分方式，解决了异构芯片差异性带来的负载均衡和计算阻塞问题。同时，还开发出异构情况下的通信感知、计算通信并行等加速模块，大幅提升异构集群计算性能。

DeepLink助力异构新兴算力高效互联
为推动更繁荣的人工智能软硬件生态，上海AI实验室积极主导标准建设。会上发布的《智算中心能力验收规范》团体标准定义了智算中心验收环节应满足的多项能力要求，适用于对智算中心在算力、存力、通信能力及应用场景支持能力等方面的评估验收，为国内算力中心建设提供了可行性标准指引。

CN.title: 提升大模型训练速度近五成，Centauri助推算力高效应用
CN.introduction: 大模型训练如何再提速？基于优化计算框架Centauri，模型训练有望加速近五成。

content.content: 大模型训练如何再提速？基于优化计算框架Centauri，模型训练有望加速近五成。
由上海人工智能实验室（上海AI实验室）与香港中文大学、北京大学联合团队提出的大模型计算优化框架Centauri，在海内外顶会屡获大奖，先后获计算机体系结构支持国际会议（ACM ASPLOS）、中国算力大会（CCPC）颁发最佳论文奖。
new2024_1.JPEG
近日，上海AI实验室凭借优化计算框架Centauri，在郑州召开的2024中国算力大会上获颁“算力中国·最佳学术论文奖”
论文标题：
content.link: Centauri: Enabling Efficient Scheduling for Communication-Computation Overlap in Large Model Training via Communication Partitioning

content.content: 论文链接：
作为涵盖体系结构、编程语言、操作系统等多个专业领域的国际顶尖学术会议之一，ACM ASPLOS的录用代表着相关专业研究的国际顶尖水平，其评选出来的最佳论文更是代表了当年度具有重大创新价值和技术突破性的学术成果。

中国算力大会由工业和信息化部发起，为首个聚焦算力领域的国家级会议。大会每年征集并评选出“最佳学术论文”，涵盖通用算力智能计算、算力应用等领域，旨在表彰算力技术突破，推广应用赋能。两获“最佳论文”殊荣，展现了实验室在AI训练与计算系统构建方面的技术积淀。在题为《Centauri: Enabling Efficient Scheduling for Communication-Computation Overlap in Large Model Training via Communication Partitioning》（通过通信切分实现大模型训练中通信计算重叠的高效调度）的论文中，上海AI实验室提出以“通信切分+重叠调度”为主要策略的通信-计算覆盖优化框架Centauri，基于该框架，当前主流大模型可实现训练速度提升45%。
CCPC评审专家认为，Centauri针对“通信是负载在设备群上的映射变换”这一模型训练任务特点，构造出了全面且能够系统化探索的切分空间和调度层级，从而实现了算力相关研究的重要突破。
new2024_2.PNG
ACM ASPLOS最佳论文获奖证书
当前，大模型训练通常采用混合并行的方法，即把多种通信集合集成到分布式分区图中。在此过程中，降低通信延迟对提升训练速度尤为关键。现有方法主要通过通信与计算重叠来减缓通信延迟，该方法倾向于依赖细粒度的内核融合和有限的操作调度，但却使异构训练环境下的训练提速受到限制。
针对大模型训练过程中巨大的通信成本和延迟，Centauri通过原语替换、拓扑感知与工作负载三个固有抽象维度的划分空间，将混合并行训练中的调度任务分解为操作、层级和模型三个层次，从而有效降低了通信延迟，达成多种分布式训练方法并行配置下的算力高效应用。

当前，互联互通已成为AI产业发展的关键一环。AI大模型、芯片等软硬件厂商及学术研究机构面临多样化、深层次的沟通合作需求。针对AI产业特征，上海AI实验室发起DeepLink合作伙伴生态计划，旨在搭建中立、高效的桥梁，为算力提供方、使用方，以及智算中心建设方等伙伴提供交流及需求对接的平台，助力提升国产算力的易用性。

在生态计划体系中，算力提供方和应用机构将以会议交流、适配认证、芯片评测等形式为路径深度交融，加快研发成果的落地推广，共同推进生态建设，打造软硬件适配落地示范标杆。同时，该计划将从AI硬件评测、与软件适配性、标准三个方面着手，以公平中立的视角联合各方制定评级认证标准。合作伙伴将根据评级，获得联合研发、联合授权、资源共享、培训赋能等权益。作为AI软硬件评测体系与标准建设的先行者，实验室主编了《人工智能 深度学习编译器接口》《人工智能软硬件适配接口》《智算中心能力验收规范》等国家、地方、团体标准，并作为lEEE异构人工智能软硬件适配标准工作组主席，牵头AI编译器国际先进标准研制。借助DeepLink生态计划，实验室将进一步发挥技术积淀及资源整合优势，直击行业痛点，助推软硬件深度融合形成合力。

DeepLink芯片评测是基于团体标准评测方法，对送测芯片进行技术规格、软件生态、功能、性能等多维度测试，并按季度产出硬件评测报告。评测工作启动一年多以来，已为10余家国产芯片厂商进行了6次芯片评测工作，发布近50份评测报告。部分企业已将评测内容、方法和流程引入其芯片测试流程，指导其芯片研发方向。同时，评测结果也为应用企业和开发者提供参考，帮助其选择更符合需求的硬件，以优化改进应用程序性能。本次发布的2024年第二季度芯片评测方案，延续开放共建经验，在充分吸收厂商及用户反馈的基础上，为大模型能力评测方案增设了文本生成模型和场景化测试，并调整了文本生成大模型的性能评估逻辑、吞吐的计算逻辑。每种方案中指标的选取会全面评估 AI 芯片的硬件质量、软件支持、功能特性和性能表现，为开发者和用户提供详细的判断和选择的依据。本次交流会上，同时发布了评测基准的最新Log和基准值镜像。上海AI实验室和上海电信联合编制的团体标准《智算中心能力验收规范》也于近期立项通过。

CN.title: DIPU仓库迭代更新-“deeplink.framework” 正式开源！
CN.introduction: 近日，DeepLink的已开源的DIPU仓库与DICP结合，并正式更名为“deeplink.framework”！目前已合并发布，欢迎各位开发者试用！

content.content: 近日，DeepLink的已开源的DIPU仓库与DICP结合，并正式更名为“deeplink.framework”！目前已合并发布，欢迎各位开发者试用！

deeplink.framework是DeepLink推出的介于AI训练框架和硬件语言之间的训练系统，同时支持Eager 模式和 Graph 模式两种链路。Framework 仓库主要由 DIPU (Device Independent Process Unit) 和 DICP (Device Independent Compile Protocol） 两部分组成，framework 中对 Eager 模式的支持，主要由 DIPU 完成 ， framework 中对 Graph 模式的支持主要由 DICP 完成。
DIPU

DIPU是由一组抽象设备 Runtime 接口，一组框架能力相关的运行时基类/接口，一个针对 DIOPI 标准算子的适配层共同组成的拓展包。 DIPU在训练框架上接入 DIOPI 算子库，实现 Eager 模式的推理和训练同时可以对用户屏蔽厂商的实际设备。其能够在编译时，决定抽象设备被影射的方式；并使用统一的运行时，减少在多硬件上适配训练框架的成本。DIPU 即可以基于统一的设备运行时来屏蔽厂商的实际设备；也可以基于统一的框架相关的运行时基类，由厂商自行实现特有的运行时逻辑。
DICP

标准编译协议定义了统一的计算描述（中间表示），通过图获取模块获得深度学习模型中的计算任务，并表达为统一的中间表示形式（计算图）；然后通过计算图优化技术并自动生成人工智能芯片设备代码，从而提高研发效率和计算的执行性能。中间表示是介于源语言和目标语言之间的程序表示，能够极大程度地提高编译流程的可拓展性，同时也能降低优化流程对前端和后端的破坏。多层次中间表示包含从应用到芯片端的多种表示层次，不同层次旨在解决不同尺度的问题。

content.content: 近日，DeepLink的测评体系仓库-“AIChipBenchmark”已经正式对外开源！欢迎各厂商踊跃参与测评！
上海人工智能实验室牵头的硬件测评基于团体标准评测方法，以国际主流芯片的性能作为对标，对送测芯片进行技术规格、软件生态、功能、性能等多维度测试，并按季度产出硬件评测报告。评测结论可为各类国产加速卡在不同维度的表现提供参考。
什么是硬件测评
硬件测评是面向深度学习加速卡进行的多维度评测工作。硬件测评提供一套标准的行业测试方法，提供技术规格、软件生态、功能测试、性能测试等多视角，并周期性产出标准测评结果。硬件测评结果可用作各类国产加速卡在不同维度表现的参考。
目前硬件测评设计了两个层面的实施方案，分别是AI芯片评测实施方案和基于大模型的AI芯片评测实施方案，以应对市场对硬件在不同场景下的能力要求。
为什么做硬件测评
硬件测评适用于芯片生产厂商、应用厂商、前场销售及第三方机构对计算机视觉领域面向云侧的深度学习训练芯片（包含AI芯片模组和AI加速卡等形态）进行设计、采购、评测。
测评流程
DeepLink将以季度为单位对测评标准进行迭代，并定期开展芯片测评工作。测评流程如下图所示：
news-20231114-cn.jpeg
1. 季度测评开始前，联系硬件测评工作人员(或邮件联系”deeplink_benchmark@pjlab.org.cn”)，确认参与本季度测评。
2. 季度测评开始，基于实施方案对自家芯片进行测试，并进行数据汇总。
3. 相关链接可见：

4. 厂商提交数据和验证材料，实验室会进行结果核验。
5. 实验室完成单芯片评测报告整理，点对点发放。
6. 厂商可对评测数据进行反馈。

content.content: 搭建适配“桥梁”，实现软硬件解耦
当前，人工智能研究在软硬件两端同时发力：成熟完善的基础软件体系、紧密协同的上层软件生态、有效衔接的下游价值链闭环已初步形成；在硬件端，涵盖计算芯片、开源平台、基础应用、行业应用及产品等环节的人工智能产业链也正逐步构建完善。但当前，支持硬件芯片适配的模型少、易用性低、性能较差、应用场景较为局限等问题依然存在。在此背景下，探索人工智能底层技术软硬件适配途径成为重大行业需求。
针对行业现状，上海AI实验室推出人工智能开放计算体系DeepLink，旨在搭建对硬件芯片与深度学习软件框架进行适配的桥梁。
DeepLink提供“算子模式+编译模式”双路径接入标准，并针对不同硬件芯片的不同适配需求，开放多层次接入技术，着力性能提升。目前DeepLink已支持多后端接入PyTorch2.0编译链路，对接国际主流生态，具备多场景的性能优势。
在DeepLink体系下，硬件一次适配即可兼容多款框架，极大降低算力使用门槛，提升整体的训练效率。以硬件适配为例，芯片厂商完成算子适配后，即可无缝对接多款主流深度学习框架。以单模型平均30-40个算子计算，平均适配一个模型的开发时间可从2人月减少至1人月，开发效率提升100%。
上海AI实验室还与50余家机构共同参与由中国电子技术标准化研究院牵头的国家标准编制工作，引导产业共同建设软硬件适配标准。目前，DeepLink构建的评测标准已被多家硬件厂商认可，DeepLink按季度对芯片进行多维度测试并出具评测报告，该报告已成为各类硬件加速卡的优化参考。
开源开放，助力AI软硬件生态体系建设
互联互通已成为AI产业发展的关键一环。DeepLink基于现有软硬件厂商合作基础，为硬件芯片提供统一的适配方案，降低开发者的门槛和成本，发挥硬件芯片的性能并提升兼容性，积累框架适配硬件的成功经验。
目前，DeepLink已向全社会开源，促进多方软硬件的协同和创新。在与硬件芯片适配的同时，DeepLink还具备对CV、NLP等任务的支持能力，已完成LLaMa、书生·浦语等大语言模型的硬件推理适配。
未来，DeepLink将持续扩展多芯片和多框架接入能力，引导产学研密切协同，充分发挥硬件芯片的特性和优势，不断完善对AIGC、CV、NLP、NeRF大模型的支持，优化标准硬件评测指标，推动硬件芯片的应用落地，打造开放高效的人工智能生态。

CN.introduction: 上海人工智能实验室研究团队发布首个专注于人工智能算子的评测集。已有人工智能评测体系关注深度学习网络在特定整体系统下的性能，以及不同深度学习框架在不同卷积神经网络下的综合评测。该工作专注在算子的计算层面，人工智能算子评测集不仅包含深度学习中的基础算子，例如卷积、池化、切片和转置等，而且首次提出长尾算子概念。长尾算子是指深度学习网络中和领域相关的计算，例如检测网络中的锚框操作，强化学习中智能体与环境的交互，语音识别中描述语句之间距离的算子。这些算子往往没有对应的设备端实现，需要借助Python解释器，由基础算子组合执行，因此往往会有较大的性能开销，例如大量的算子调用开销，不必要的数据搬运以及上下文切换。

第51届“国际并行处理大会”（ICPP，International Conference on Parallel Processing）将于2022年8月29日-9月1日召开。ICPP是最老的计算机会议之一，是专注并行计算编程，算法，应用和体系结构领域的顶级会议。上海人工智能实验室训练与计算团队研究人员论文被大会接收。

本文针对深度学习中的View类算子提出了相关算子融合和优化策略。View类算子是指输出和输入共享物理存储的算子，典型View类算子包括Basic Indexing算子，reshape算子，expand算子等。View类算子在深度学习中属于高频算子，然而其计算特征会破坏静态单赋值（SSA）形式，因此如何进行图优化是一个非常重要的研究课题。本文提出EasyView方案，将计算转化为静态单赋值形式的同时，可以提高访存效率减少数据搬运。
news-04.png
EasyView方案相比业内相关工作均有明显性能提升，包含View算子的函数相比XLA、JAX和TorchScript性能提升分别为5.63、2.44和4.67倍。整体网络性能相比PyTorch原生模式提升8%。

论文第一作者为蒋丽娟，通讯作者为李秀红，合作单位有商汤科技、北京大学和中科院软件所。文章具体信息：Lijuan Jiang, Ping Xu, Qianchao Zhu, Xiuhong Li, Shengen Yan, Xingcheng Zhang, Dahua Lin, Wenjing Ma, Zhouyang Li, Jun Liu, Jinmin Ma, Minxi Jin, and Chao Yang, "EasyView: Enabling and Scheduling Tensor Views in Deep Learning Compilers", in the proceeding of 51st International Conference on Parallel Processing (ICPP)

Professor Dahua Lin (first from left), a leading scientist at the Shanghai AI Laboratory, accepted the award on behalf of the laboratory.

As the highest award of WAIC, the SAIL Award was established in 2018 and is selected annually from a global perspective to commend global artificial intelligence innovation projects that lead technological innovation and transformation and create a better future life. The SAIL Award is divided into five sub-awards，representing Superior, Applicative, Innovative, Leading, and the awarded projects are highly recognized and reputable in the field of artificial intelligence.

Adaptation, assessment, and standardization are carried out simultaneously to support industrial deployment

The DeepLink  Artificial Intelligence Open Computing System aims to build a bridge for the adaptation of hardware chips and deep learning software frameworks, jointly constructing an open software and hardware adaptation ecosystem. It provides unified and convenient programming interfaces for various mainstream intelligent computing chips, achieving decoupling between artificial intelligence training frameworks and underlying hardware architectures.

Based on DeepLink, developers can switch freely between various hardware and algorithm ecosystems with a single programming effort, significantly shortening the adaptation time and overall lowering the threshold for computing power usage.
To date, DeepLink has collaborated with more than ten hardware enterprises and has implemented training and inference adaptation for multiple models on many computing platforms.

DeepLink actively leads chip evaluation work across the industry, improving AI computing power assessment methods and benchmarks in the era of large models, providing guidance for chip enterprises' product iteration and intelligent computing center selection. Up to now, DeepLink has conducted seven chip evaluation sessions, producing about 70 evaluation reports for manufacturers to iterate their products. It has a test plan capable of handling thousands of cards and has promoted the formulation of national and local standards in multiple countries.
Open Collaboration, Gathering Ecosystem Partners

At  WAIC 2024 Science Frontiers Main Forum held on July 4th, the DeepLink Ecosystem Partner Plan was officially launched, with the initial gathering of over 20 institutions. This plan aims to build a neutral and efficient bridge providing a platform for communication and demand matching among partners such as computing power providers, users, and intelligent computing center builders, to help enhance the usability of domestic computing power.

Within the ecosystem program system, computing power providers and application institutions will deeply integrate through paths such as conference exchanges, adaptation certification, and chip evaluations, accelerating the implementation and promotion of research and development achievements and jointly advancing ecosystem construction to create a benchmark for software and hardware adaptation implementation.

At the same time, the plan will start from three aspects: AI hardware evaluation, software adaptability, and standards, and jointly formulate rating certification standards from a fair and neutral perspective. Partners will receive benefits such as joint R&D, joint authorization, resource sharing, and training empowerment according to their ratings.

EN.title: OpenTenNet framework: software and hardware collaboration, breaking through the energy efficiency barrier of quantum computing
EN.introduction: Recently, Shanghai Artificial Intelligence Laboratory (Shanghai AI Laboratory) jointly released the quantum simulation parallel framework OpenTenNet with the University of Science and Technology of China, the Chinese Academy of Sciences, etc., to break through the energy efficiency barrier of "quantum hegemony" with software and hardware collaboration, and provide new algorithm support for the foundation of artificial intelligence computing power.

content.content: Recently, Shanghai Artificial Intelligence Laboratory (Shanghai AI Laboratory) jointly released the quantum simulation parallel framework OpenTenNet with the University of Science and Technology of China, the Chinese Academy of Sciences, etc., to break through the energy efficiency barrier of "quantum hegemony" with software and hardware collaboration, and provide new algorithm support for the foundation of artificial intelligence computing power.

Integrating OpenTenNet and the optimization of emerging computing power cluster systems, the research team and MetaX built a quantum computing simulator on emerging computing power hardware for the first time, achieving performance improvements in scalability, computing efficiency, green energy consumption, etc., and further lowering the application threshold of "quantum computing" under the traditional hardware mode.

The relevant results paper has been published at the 2024 Global Supercomputing Conference (SC24). In the future, the laboratory will continue to rely on original algorithms and emerging computing power to accelerate the construction of AI software and hardware adaptation bridges, and work with all parties to promote innovation in AI algorithms and computing power applications.
Paper: https://ieeexplore.ieee.org/abstract/document/10793197
Github: https://github.com/DeepLink-org/OpenTenNet
Competition between "quantum" and "classical" generates innovation momentum

Quantum computing is a concept and technology system for information processing developed based on the principles of quantum mechanics. It is believed that it has the potential to achieve exponential acceleration of computing efficiency. At the same time, it is widely concerned by the research community because it is not limited by the limits of classical computer transistors. Since complex and highly entangled quantum systems are difficult to simulate efficiently using classical computers, physicist Feynman proposed to use controllable quantum computers to study quantum systems and realize efficient application of quantum computing. Previously, the quantum chip Sycamore surpassed the capabilities of classical computers in specific tasks, announcing the realization of "quantum hegemony". With the continuous potential of quantum computing in NISQ (intermediate-scale quantum including noise), quantum circuit simulators on various classical computers have emerged, and bridging "quantum hegemony" with traditional hardware has become the focus of the research community. But at the same time, there are the following challenges in simulating quantum circuits with classical computers:
1. The large number of quantum bits that make up the quantum system (corresponding to spatial complexity);
2. The vertical depth of the quantum system (corresponding to temporal complexity);
3. As the scale of quantum circuits expands, the amount of information required grows exponentially.
OpenTenNet framework efficiently implements quantum simulators

Previously, the industry has made some progress in quantum simulation research using supercomputing clusters, but the communication overhead and energy consumption burden caused by the contraction of ultra-large-scale tensor networks are still obstacles to classical computing's impact on "quantum hegemony".

For the contraction of large-scale tensor networks in quantum simulation, the Shanghai AI Laboratory and the joint team combined the latest quantum simulation algorithm proposed by USTC to launch the OpenTenNet framework to solve the problems of computing efficiency and overhead under memory-constrained conditions. Using three-level parallel architecture, customized low-precision communication, recalculation and other technologies to alleviate the communication bottleneck between nodes, for the first time, a high-performance and low-power quantum circuit simulator was built on new computing power hardware.

Through the OpenTenNet algorithm, the research team converted the quantum simulation task into a contraction problem of large-scale tensor networks. Under memory-constrained conditions, "simulated annealing" was used to search for a contraction path with a computational complexity close to the optimal, and a post-selection processing algorithm was used to improve the cross-entropy benchmark XEB value, with lower computational complexity under the same XEB value.

In order to benchmark the quantum chip Sycamore to achieve the task of "quantum hegemony", the joint team conducted multiple groups of control experiments at different tensor network scales. Combining algorithm and system-level optimization, the quantum simulator based on OpenTenNet has achieved performance improvements in scalability, speed, power consumption, etc. As shown in the figure below, as the number of GPUs increases, the time required for the total task decreases linearly, while energy consumption remains at a stable level, showing good parallelism and high scalability.

OpenTenNet Scalability Analysis
Software and hardware collaboration, breaking through "quantum supremacy"

Based on the OpenTenNet algorithm, the research team and MetaX conducted a series of adaptations and optimizations on the quantum model on the MX C500 chip: high-dimensional Tensor operation operators optimized according to memory access characteristics, high-performance GEMM computing mathematical libraries fully utilizing the GPU Matrix Core, and high-bandwidth, low-latency communication libraries to achieve data transmission between cards.

The test results are shown in the figure below, where the rectangle represents the quantum chip Sycamore, the triangle represents the existing classical simulation algorithm, and the circle represents the quantum simulation calculator built by the Shanghai AI Laboratory joint team. Using Sycamore to generate three million unrelated sampling experiments as a control, it can be seen that the latest quantum simulation computing method has achieved energy consumption and efficiency advantages over Sycamore (pink area). With the collaboration of software and hardware, classical computing power has successfully surpassed Sycamore's "quantum supremacy".

Shanghai AI Laboratory continues to lay out the construction of a new generation of AI training and computing systems, create a broadly inclusive AI computing and compilation system, innovate the training system programming paradigm, explore the energy efficiency limit of model training, and meet the needs of the integration of general intelligence and ultra-large-scale scientific computing. The DeepLink artificial intelligence open computing system built by the laboratory builds a bridge between computing hardware and deep learning software framework, jointly promoting breakthroughs in artificial intelligence technology from both software and hardware aspects.

EN.introduction: On November 26, the 3rd Computing Network and Digital Economy Forum and the 2024 'Computing Power Pujiang' Summary Conference were held in Shanghai. At the meeting, the Shanghai Artificial Intelligence Laboratory (Shanghai AI Laboratory) released the latest achievements of open computing and general-specialized integrated large models: for the first time, the domestic emerging computing power heterogeneous interconnection technology was fully supported in the large model training, and the all-round multi-modal generation large model - InternLumina was fully trained.

content.content: On November 26, the 3rd Computing Network and Digital Economy Forum and the 2024 'Computing Power Pujiang' Summary Conference were held in Shanghai. At the meeting, the Shanghai Artificial Intelligence Laboratory (Shanghai AI Laboratory) released the latest achievements of open computing and general-specialized integrated large models: for the first time, the domestic emerging computing power heterogeneous interconnection technology was fully supported in the large model training, and the all-round multi-modal generation large model - InternLumina was fully trained.

Taking advantage of the original algorithm and the deep interconnection technology of AI software and hardware, Shanghai AI Laboratory jointly with emerging computing power providers such as Infinigence AI, Iluvatar Corex, MetaX and Suanfeng Information conducted cross-domain heterogeneous interconnection technology exploration and achieved a new breakthrough in heterogeneous mixed training technology: experimental results show that the mixed training efficiency of InternLumina in the heterogeneous cluster composed of emerging computing power is 97.5%, and the computing efficiency is 1.6 times higher than before optimization.

The capabilities of InternLumina cover multi-modal generation tasks such as multi-round dialogue, visual understanding, controllable generation, and multi-round editing, which can accurately respond to complex challenges in actual application scenarios. In the field of generative technology, the Shanghai AI Lab research team has taken a step further in the 'general and specialized integration' technology path that combines general generative capabilities with professional generalization capabilities by creating a collaboratively developed algorithm framework.

The meeting also released the 'Acceptance specification for intelligent computing center capability' group standard, which was guided by the Shanghai Communications Administration and led by the laboratory and China Telecom and other institutions. With the DeepLink artificial intelligence open computing system as the carrier, the Shanghai AI Lab will continue to promote the deep coupling of artificial intelligence software and hardware, and work with industry partners to promote the efficient application of emerging computing power and the construction of AI infrastructure.

InternLumina's capabilities cover multiple tasks such as multi-round dialogue, visual understanding, controllable generation, and multi-round editing. Based on multi-language multi-granularity image understanders, diffuse image generation models, diffuse video generation models, and multi-task all-round generation models, an 'all-round' multimodal generation model is built.

Multiple base models to build 'all-round generation'

The image understander supports Chinese and English, and supports high-resolution and arbitrary-resolution content annotation. Users can flexibly define multi-granular content understanding methods from simple labels to long text descriptions, building a solid foundation for other tasks;

The image generation model targets the pain points of AI creation in the Chinese community. Users can generate high-quality images of multiple cultures, multiple fields, and multiple styles in Chinese and English;
The diffusion video generation model supports video generation of any length, any resolution, and multiple styles;

The all-round generation model comprehensively covers multiple tasks such as multi-round dialogue, visual understanding, controllable generation, and multi-round editing, providing strong technical support for intelligent generation in multiple fields.

In order to achieve the research goals of multi-modal, multi-task, and all-round generation, the Shanghai AI Laboratory research team introduced the command interactive 'understanding-association' mechanism and enhanced understanding methods to make the generation process orderly and controllable, and the generation effect 'more reliable'. Based on the command interactive 'understanding-association' mechanism, it can provide users with fine-grained and controllable creation methods, generate diversified dialogues, pictures, and videos including traditional Chinese cultural characteristics, thereby enabling posters, animations, and other design creations to serve different application needs in real life.

Following the concept of 'enhanced understanding', the research team customized and developed a multi-language, multi-granular, ultra-high-definition resolution image understander for InternLumina to create an efficient parsing and semantic generation foundation for input content. The labeler is suitable for both Chinese and English, supports content annotation at any resolution, and adapts to diverse scene understanding. Users can flexibly define content understanding methods from single labels to long text descriptions, deconstruct complex data, ensure the accuracy and richness of generated content, effectively reduce the 'hallucination' phenomenon in the generation model, and realize the co-evolution of 'understanding-generation'.
Heterogeneous mixed training: verifying the cross-domain collaborative potential of emerging computing power

InternLumina, as the first heterogeneous mixed training multimodal large model based on emerging computing power, further breaks through the performance boundary of cross-domain heterogeneous interconnection technology.

Under the premise of limited computing resources, through cross-domain heterogeneous interconnection, chips with different computing power performance can be freely combined without relying on a single high-computing power chip 'grouping'; at the same time, different computing power clusters can achieve scale efficiency through combination. Through heterogeneous interconnection, the hardware barriers of different computing power manufacturers can also be reduced to promote ecological prosperity.

However, for a long time, due to the closed source nature of hardware manufacturers, the incompatibility of chip operation drivers, computing software and upper-level frameworks, and the low communication efficiency between different hardware, it has been difficult for computing power users to call more than two chips for calculation at the same time, which seriously limits the efficiency of computing power use.

Using DeepLink artificial intelligence open computing system as a carrier, Shanghai AI Laboratory, together with emerging computing power suppliers such as Infinigence AI, Iluvatar Corex, MetaX and Suanfeng Information , successfully realized large-scale model mixed training fully supported by emerging computing power for the first time. The experimental results verify that under the new technical solution, InternLumina achieved a mixed training efficiency of 97.5% in a heterogeneous cluster composed of emerging computing power, and the computing efficiency was increased by 1.6 times compared with before optimization.

Based on heterogeneous chips, the Deeplink team built an adaptation layer based on the existing communication protocol, coordinating different hardware manufacturers to achieve interconnection and communication between heterogeneous chips through RDMA (Remote Direct Memory Access) or CPU transfer, breaking through the closed-source incompatibility problem of heterogeneous chips.

For parallel strategies, Deeplink uses the self-developed InternEvo distributed parallel framework to solve the load balancing and computing blockage problems caused by the differences in heterogeneous chips in a more fine-grained splitting method. At the same time, it has also developed acceleration modules such as communication perception and computing and communication parallelism in heterogeneous situations, which greatly improves the computing performance of heterogeneous clusters.

Winning the 'Best Paper' award twice demonstrates the laboratory's technical accumulation in AI training and computing system construction. In the paper entitled 'Centauri: Enabling Efficient Scheduling for Communication-Computation Overlap in Large Model Training via Communication Partitioning', the Shanghai AI Laboratory proposed the communication-computing coverage optimization framework Centauri with 'communication partitioning + overlapping scheduling' as the main strategy. Based on this framework, the current mainstream large models can achieve a 45% increase in training speed.

CCPC review experts believe that Centauri has constructed a comprehensive and systematically explorable segmentation space and scheduling hierarchy based on the model training task characteristic of 'communication is a mapping transformation loaded on a group of devices', thus achieving an important breakthrough in computing power-related research.

Currently, large model training usually adopts a hybrid parallel approach, that is, integrating multiple communication sets into a distributed partition graph. In this process, reducing communication latency is particularly critical to improving training speed. Existing methods mainly reduce communication latency by overlapping communication and computing. This method tends to rely on fine-grained kernel fusion and limited operation scheduling, but it limits the training speed-up in heterogeneous training environments.

In response to the huge communication costs and delays in the training process of large models, Centauri divides the space into three inherent abstract dimensions: primitive replacement, topology awareness, and workload. It decomposes the scheduling tasks in hybrid parallel training into three levels: operation, hierarchy, and model, thereby effectively reducing communication delays and achieving efficient application of computing power under parallel configuration of multiple distributed training methods.

deeplink.framework is a training system  between the AI training framework and hardware language. It supports both Eager mode and Graph mode. The Framework repository is mainly composed of DIPU (Device Independent Process Unit) and DICP (Device Independent Compile Protocol). The support for Eager mode in the framework is mainly completed by DIPU, and the support for Graph mode in the framework is mainly completed by DICP.
DIPU

DIPU is an expansion package composed of a set of abstract device runtime interfaces, a set of runtime base classes/interfaces related to framework capabilities, and an adaptation layer for DIOPI standard operators. DIPU is connected to the DIOPI operator library on the training framework to implement Eager mode reasoning and training while shielding users from the actual equipment of the manufacturer. It can determine the way abstract devices are mapped at compile time; and uses a unified runtime to reduce the cost of adapting the training framework on multiple hardware. DIPU can be based on a unified device runtime to shield the manufacturer's actual device; it can also be based on a unified framework-related runtime base class, and the manufacturer can implement its own unique runtime logic.
DICP

The standard compilation protocol defines a unified calculation description (intermediate representation). The calculation tasks in the deep learning model are obtained through the graph acquisition module and expressed into a unified intermediate representation (computation graph); Then, the calculation graph optimization technology is used to automatically generate the artificial intelligence chip device code, thereby improving research and development efficiency and computing execution performance.The intermediate representation is a program representation between the source language and the target language, which can greatly improve the scalability of the compilation process and also reduce the damage of the optimization process to the front-end and back-end. Multi-level intermediate representation includes multiple representation levels from application to chip side, and different levels are designed to solve problems at different scales.

EN.title: Shanghai Artificial Intelligence Laboratory Released the First Evaluation Set for Deep Learning Operators
EN.introduction: The Shanghai Artificial Intelligence Laboratory research team released the first evaluation set concerning deep learning operators.

content.content: news-01-en.png
The Shanghai Artificial Intelligence Laboratory research team released the first evaluation set concerning deep learning operators.

The existing artificial intelligence evaluation systems focus on the overall performance of deep learning networks under a certain architecture and the comprehensive evaluation of different deep learning frameworks running various convolutional neural networks. This work focuses on the computing level concerning operators. The released evaluation set for deep learning operators includes basic operators, such as convolution, pooling, slicing, and transpose, and also proposes the concept of long-tail operators for the first time. Long-tail operators refer to domain-specific calculations in deep learning neural networks, such as anchor-related computations in object detection networks, interactions between agents and environments in reinforcement learning, and operators that calculate the distance between sentences in speech recognition. Those operators often lack efficient device kernels, which are then translated into a combination of basic operators by the Python interpreter accordingly. Therefore, a significant performance overhead usually exists, such as a large amount of operator calling overhead, unnecessary data transfer, and context switching.

The operator evaluation set includes an input processing module, an operator module, an execution engine, and an analysis module. The input processing module arranges the input information of operators in the real models. The operator module contains the implementation and calling logic of operators. The execution engine includes a variety of existing deep learning frameworks. The analysis module is used to statistically analyze the performance-related data. At present, the operator evaluation set includes 200+ AI basic operators and 100+ AI long-tail operators, which can conduct multi-dimensional and systematic evaluation and analysis of AI chips and deep learning compilers.

The 51st International Conference on Parallel Processing (ICPP) was held from August 29 to September 1, 2022. ICPP is one of the oldest top conferences on parallel computing programming, algorithms, applications, and architectures. The paper by the researchers from the training and computing team of the Shanghai Artificial Intelligence Laboratory was accepted by ICPP'22.

This paper proposes an end-to-end fusion and optimization strategy for view-related operators in deep learning neural networks whose input and output tensors share the same physical storage. Typical view-related operators include basic indexing, reshape, and expand, etc. View-related operators are of high frequency, but their computational characteristics destroy the static single assignment (SSA) form, which makes graph optimization on views an important research topic. This paper proposes EasyView, which improves memory access efficiency and reduces data transfer overhead while converting the calculation into an SSA form.
news-04.png

EasyView could get an average of 5.63X, 2.44X, and 4.67X speedup compared with the XLA, JAX, and TorchScript, respectively for hotspot Python functions. In addition, operation fusion with views could bring 8.02% performance improvement in end-to-end neural networks. EasyView is a cooperative effort by SenseTime, Peking University, and the Institute of Software, Chinese Academy of Sciences.  More information of the work: Lijuan Jiang, Ping Xu, Qianchao Zhu, Xiuhong Li, Shengen Yan, Xingcheng Zhang, Dahua Lin, Wenjing Ma, Zhouyang Li, Jun Liu, Jinmin Ma, Minxi Jin, and Chao Yang, "EasyView: Enabling and Scheduling Tensor Views in Deep Learning Compilers", in the proceeding of 51st International Conference on Parallel Processing (ICPP).
